task: Find an electric bicycle, understand its price and open the relevant details.
audience: Prospective catalog visitors; no participants recruited.
scope: Current Arngren phone390x844 and desktop1440x1000 captures plus category navigation probe,2026-11-15. Failed counter-image resource leaves readiness incomplete.
identityToPreserve: Direct category vocabulary, visible product/price cues and abundant catalog content.
strengths: An electric-bicycle category link is visible and successfully opens sykkel.html.
The initial phone view contains a bicycle image and price; clutter does not prove this task impossible.

scenarios.evidence: No participant test, purchase or comprehension observation.

adaptation.reason: The phone document has3105px of root horizontal excess; the category view separates task-relevant product context from the initial narrow frame.
adaptation.tradeoff: Keep product abundance and direct category access; excessive spaciousness or hidden navigation could worsen scanning.

findings.location: Phone390 CSS px viewport, current catalog and bicycle category
findings.observation: Actual body scroller is3495px wide:3105px beyond the phone viewport. Old root-only collector incorrectly reported zero. Category navigation works, but the initial category frame lacks the nearby photo/price context.
findings.intendedRelationship: Product identity, photo, price and detail action should remain understandable together within the available space.
findings.consequence: Large root scrolling and separated product context can make scanning/comparison harder. This is an inference; an agent successfully found the category, and no participant failure rate was measured.
findings.proposal: Recompose catalog items and category detail for narrow screens while retaining visible categories and product abundance. Aim for no page-level overflow of ordinary product content; evaluate any necessary local scroller separately.
findings.preserve: Working category path, clear prices on visible items and direct catalog character.
findings.alternative: Keep dense desktop organization if it serves comparison; density itself is not the defect. Do not globally normalize type or remove products to reduce warning count.
findings.verification: After any authorized implementation, recapture390/1440px and follow the same category path; verify identity/photo/price association and keyboard reachability. This evaluation did not modify Arngren.

unknowns: A broken third-party counter image was observed; overall automated readiness remains incomplete.
Full product comparison and purchase were not tested.
Motion, screen-reader behavior and all automated candidates remain outside this scoped semantic finding.
